name: k12_mg1655_real_ont
key_challenge: Real ONT error structure (homopolymers, chimeras, adapter remnants, length tail) that simulation cannot reproduce

real_reads.platform: Oxford Nanopore MinION (ENA instrument model: MinION)

subsample.method: first 10,000 records of the ENA fastq (deterministic; ~90 Mb, ~19x of MG1655)

truth.none: Real reads: no ground-truth placement and no truth TSV. Use for wall time, peak RSS and phraya-vs-minimap2 placement agreement only.

benchmark_notes: Do not report PA. SRR8184499 was chosen as a single-run, single-end MG1655 ONT WGS set of manageable size (402 MB gz). Confirm on staging that >=95% of reads map to NC_000913.3 with minimap2 -x map-ont before using.
